trophies.name: Vice Got a Price!
sources: Exophase — Grand Theft Auto VI trophy list
PSNProfiles — Grand Theft Auto VI trophy guide
trophies.guide: The platinum pops by itself once the other 54 are done — there is no extra task. Follow the roadmap below and check trophies off as you go; this one arrives with the last of them.

trophies.name: Just Like Paradise
sources: Exophase — Grand Theft Auto VI trophy list
PSNProfiles — Grand Theft Auto VI trophy guide
trophies.guide: Play the opening mission Gone Fishing to the end. It is the first mission, so this is the first trophy most players earn.

trophies.name: Paradise Lost
sources: Exophase — Grand Theft Auto VI trophy list
PSNProfiles — Grand Theft Auto VI trophy guide
trophies.guide: Clear every mission in Chapter 1. The trophy lands when the chapter's closing mission ends.

trophies.name: T**s Ass Drug Money
sources: Exophase — Grand Theft Auto VI trophy list
PSNProfiles — Grand Theft Auto VI trophy guide
trophies.guide: Work through Chapter 2's mission line. Nothing in this chapter can be missed, so just keep playing the story.

trophies.name: Vice City, Baby!
sources: Exophase — Grand Theft Auto VI trophy list
PSNProfiles — Grand Theft Auto VI trophy guide
trophies.guide: Finish Chapter 3 from start to end. The trophy pops at the chapter's final mission.

trophies.name: Top Of The World, Ma
sources: Exophase — Grand Theft Auto VI trophy list
PSNProfiles — Grand Theft Auto VI trophy guide
trophies.guide: Play Chapter 4 through to its last mission. After this, only the finale stands between you and the gold story trophy.

trophies.name: You Gotta Know When to Get Off
sources: Exophase — Grand Theft Auto VI trophy list
PSNProfiles — Grand Theft Auto VI trophy guide
trophies.guide: Beat the final mission. Before you start it, make sure the one missable trophy (Positive Mental Attitude) is already done.

trophies.name: Trust
sources: Exophase — Grand Theft Auto VI trophy list
PSNProfiles — Grand Theft Auto VI trophy guide
trophies.guide: Complete the Breakfast Run mission when it comes up in the story. It unlocks naturally as the plot moves along.

trophies.name: Break the Bank
sources: Exophase — Grand Theft Auto VI trophy list
PSNProfiles — Grand Theft Auto VI trophy guide
trophies.guide: Finish The Cartel Heist. Stock up on ammo and armor first — the getaway is the hard part, not the vault.

trophies.name: Family Matters
sources: Exophase — Grand Theft Auto VI trophy list
PSNProfiles — Grand Theft Auto VI trophy guide
trophies.guide: Complete the Child's Play mission. It appears in the story flow, so there is nothing extra to unlock.

trophies.name: DWNFALL
sources: Exophase — Grand Theft Auto VI trophy list
PSNProfiles — Grand Theft Auto VI trophy guide
trophies.guide: Finish the Headliners mission. Keep an eye on your wanted level during the escape and break line of sight fast.

trophies.name: Hi-Jacked
sources: Exophase — Grand Theft Auto VI trophy list
PSNProfiles — Grand Theft Auto VI trophy guide
trophies.guide: Complete the VCIA Takedown mission at the airport. The trophy pops once the takedown is done and you are clear.

trophies.name: Snow Storm
sources: Exophase — Grand Theft Auto VI trophy list
PSNProfiles — Grand Theft Auto VI trophy guide
trophies.guide: Finish Operation Savage Glory. Bring heavy weapons — the final stretch throws a lot of enemies at you.

trophies.name: A Long Road
sources: Exophase — Grand Theft Auto VI trophy list
PSNProfiles — Grand Theft Auto VI trophy guide
trophies.guide: Reach 100% on the completion stats screen: story, side strands, activities, collectibles, exploration and money all count. Save this for last and use this checklist as the plan.

trophies.name: Cunning Stunts
sources: Exophase — Grand Theft Auto VI trophy list
PSNProfiles — Grand Theft Auto VI trophy guide
trophies.guide: Pull off 250 stunts — jumps, near misses, long airtime and fast driving all add to the counter. Fold stunt attempts into normal driving instead of grinding them in one place.

trophies.name: Master of None
trophies.description: Try each type of activity once.
sources: Exophase — Grand Theft Auto VI trophy list
PSNProfiles — Grand Theft Auto VI trophy guide
trophies.guide: Try each of the 9 activity types once: fishing, races, shooting range, drone races, arcade games, bowling and the rest. You only need to try them, not win.

trophies.name: The Shootist
trophies.description: Earn a gold medal in all Shooting Range challenges.
sources: Exophase — Grand Theft Auto VI trophy list
PSNProfiles — Grand Theft Auto VI trophy guide
trophies.guide: Earn gold in all 42 Shooting Range challenges. Learn each drill's rhythm, pick the right weapon for it, and replay the ones you silver — gold rewards steady aim, not speed.

trophies.name: Top Fun
trophies.description: Win a Top Fun Drone Race at every location.
sources: Exophase — Grand Theft Auto VI trophy list
PSNProfiles — Grand Theft Auto VI trophy guide
trophies.guide: Win a Top Fun drone race at all 14 locations. Learn the gates on each course and save boost for the long straights.

trophies.name: Earn Cash, Not Kudos
sources: Exophase — Grand Theft Auto VI trophy list
PSNProfiles — Grand Theft Auto VI trophy guide
trophies.guide: Win 20 different races across the race types. Start with the shortest events and match your vehicle to the class.

trophies.name: Baited My Tackle
trophies.description: Beat Cal in a fishing challenge.
sources: Exophase — Grand Theft Auto VI trophy list
PSNProfiles — Grand Theft Auto VI trophy guide
trophies.guide: Beat Cal in a fishing challenge. Watch the line tension, reel when the fish runs toward you, and stay patient — it is a waiting game.

trophies.name: Stick Fiddler
sources: Exophase — Grand Theft Auto VI trophy list
PSNProfiles — Grand Theft Auto VI trophy guide
trophies.guide: Finish one arcade game at any cabinet. Pick a short game and play it through to the end screen.

trophies.name: Road to Rehabilitation
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Andy.
sources: Exophase — Grand Theft Auto VI trophy list
PSNProfiles — Grand Theft Auto VI trophy guide
trophies.guide: Finish Andy's final mission. His missions unlock as the story goes on, so check back with him between chapters.

trophies.name: This Was No Boat Accident
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Kenton.
sources: Exophase — Grand Theft Auto VI trophy list
PSNProfiles — Grand Theft Auto VI trophy guide
trophies.guide: Finish Kenton's final mission. Clear his jobs whenever they show up rather than leaving them for later.

trophies.name: The Lone Rider
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Billy.
sources: Exophase — Grand Theft Auto VI trophy list
PSNProfiles — Grand Theft Auto VI trophy guide
trophies.guide: Finish Billy's last mission. Work through his mission line as it opens up.

trophies.name: Strangers & Freaks
trophies.description: Complete 8 mission strands for strangers across the state of Leonida.
sources: Exophase — Grand Theft Auto VI trophy list
PSNProfiles — Grand Theft Auto VI trophy guide
trophies.guide: Complete 8 stranger mission strands across Leonida. Strangers show up as map markers — take each strand to its end, and sweep the map again after every chapter since new ones unlock.

trophies.name: Supply & Demand
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Randy.
sources: Exophase — Grand Theft Auto VI trophy list
PSNProfiles — Grand Theft Auto VI trophy guide
trophies.guide: Finish Randy's final mission. Clear his jobs as they appear in the story.

trophies.name: Spin On This!
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Tyrone.
sources: Exophase — Grand Theft Auto VI trophy list
PSNProfiles — Grand Theft Auto VI trophy guide
trophies.guide: Finish Tyrone's final mission. His line opens alongside the story — do not leave it until after the finale.

trophies.name: Positive Mental Attitude
trophies.description: Meditate at every spot across Leonida.
sources: Exophase — Grand Theft Auto VI trophy list
PSNProfiles — Grand Theft Auto VI trophy guide
trophies.guide: MISSABLE — meditate at all 18 spots across Leonida. Some spots sit in areas that change as the story moves on, so clear them while you explore each region instead of saving them for after the finale. This is the only trophy that can be missed.

trophies.name: Fair Game
trophies.description: Hunt a unique animal for Bret.
sources: Exophase — Grand Theft Auto VI trophy list
PSNProfiles — Grand Theft Auto VI trophy guide
trophies.guide: Hunt the unique animal for Bret. Follow his strand until the hunt opens, track the animal patiently, and take the shot when it stands still.

trophies.name: Don't Touch My Deck
sources: Exophase — Grand Theft Auto VI trophy list
PSNProfiles — Grand Theft Auto VI trophy guide
trophies.guide: Complete 3 collectible card sets. Cards turn up across Leonida — in shops, hidden corners and mission rewards — so grab them as you find them.

trophies.name: You WAiNKer!
sources: Exophase — Grand Theft Auto VI trophy list
PSNProfiles — Grand Theft Auto VI trophy guide
trophies.guide: WAiNK It at 100 locations. Work through the spots region by region and use the checklist to track which areas are finished.

trophies.name: One Last Thing
sources: Exophase — Grand Theft Auto VI trophy list
PSNProfiles — Grand Theft Auto VI trophy guide
trophies.guide: Complete 50 challenges. They cover driving, combat, exploration and more, and they pile up on their own — check the challenges menu often and mop up the easy ones late.

trophies.name: Hot Together
trophies.description: Lose a 4 star Wanted Level with your partner and escape the heat.
sources: Exophase — Grand Theft Auto VI trophy list
PSNProfiles — Grand Theft Auto VI trophy guide
trophies.guide: Lose a 4-star wanted level with your partner and escape. Get the heat up together, then break line of sight, switch cars, and hide until the stars clear — alleys and water help.

trophies.name: Retail Therapy
trophies.description: Rob 3 shops back-to-back with your partner without losing your Wanted Level.
sources: Exophase — Grand Theft Auto VI trophy list
PSNProfiles — Grand Theft Auto VI trophy guide
trophies.guide: Rob 3 shops back-to-back with your partner without losing your wanted level. Plan a route with three close shops, keep a fast car ready, and move quickly between them without stopping to fight.

trophies.name: Whip It Good
sources: Exophase — Grand Theft Auto VI trophy list
PSNProfiles — Grand Theft Auto VI trophy guide
trophies.guide: Discover 100 vehicles. Drive everything you see — each new model counts once, so vary your rides and visit different neighborhoods.

trophies.name: Gunslinger
trophies.description: Take down 5 enemies in a single use of Combat Focus.
sources: Exophase — Grand Theft Auto VI trophy list
PSNProfiles — Grand Theft Auto VI trophy guide
trophies.guide: Take down 5 enemies in a single use of Combat Focus. Find a group, trigger focus when they cluster, and chain headshots — tight spaces with several enemies are the best setup.

trophies.name: Catch Me If You Can
trophies.description: Make an unscheduled departure at VCIA.
sources: Exophase — Grand Theft Auto VI trophy list
PSNProfiles — Grand Theft Auto VI trophy guide
trophies.guide: Make an unscheduled departure at VCIA. Grab a plane on the airfield and get airborne fast — speed matters more than stealth here.

trophies.name: Challenging Tank
sources: Exophase — Grand Theft Auto VI trophy list
PSNProfiles — Grand Theft Auto VI trophy guide
trophies.guide: Deal with the Rhinos — the tanks. Use explosives and heavy weapons from cover, keep moving, and never trade shots in the open.

trophies.name: Sneakthief
trophies.description: Rob a jewelry store without being detected.
sources: Exophase — Grand Theft Auto VI trophy list
PSNProfiles — Grand Theft Auto VI trophy guide
trophies.guide: Rob a jewelry store without being detected. Go in quiet, watch the cameras and guards, grab the goods and leave before anyone raises the alarm.

trophies.name: Maximum Withdrawal
sources: Exophase — Grand Theft Auto VI trophy list
PSNProfiles — Grand Theft Auto VI trophy guide
trophies.guide: Rob 5 bank vaults and escape. Plan the getaway before you go in — a fast car, a route away from police, and a clean exit each time.

trophies.name: A Classic Blitz Play
trophies.description: Rob an Armored Truck and escape.
sources: Exophase — Grand Theft Auto VI trophy list
PSNProfiles — Grand Theft Auto VI trophy guide
trophies.guide: Rob an armored truck and escape. Stop the truck, take the cash, and lose the heat — a second vehicle stashed nearby makes the escape much easier.

trophies.name: The Goodtime State
sources: Exophase — Grand Theft Auto VI trophy list
PSNProfiles — Grand Theft Auto VI trophy guide
trophies.guide: Explore all 52 areas of Leonida. Drive every road and visit every corner — the map fills in as you go, and the last few areas are usually the remote ones.

trophies.name: Pest Control
trophies.description: Rob an Illegal Operation belonging to each gang.
sources: Exophase — Grand Theft Auto VI trophy list
PSNProfiles — Grand Theft Auto VI trophy guide
trophies.guide: Rob an illegal operation belonging to each of the 9 gangs. Hit a different gang's operation each time and expect heavy resistance — go in prepared.

trophies.name: In The Beginning…
trophies.description: Enjoy a cocktail with a view on Ocean Beach.
sources: Exophase — Grand Theft Auto VI trophy list
PSNProfiles — Grand Theft Auto VI trophy guide
trophies.guide: Enjoy a cocktail with a view on Ocean Beach. Find the beachside spot, order a drink, and take in the view — a quiet story moment.

trophies.name: Capital Offense
trophies.description: Smash your way out of a vehicle showroom in classic style.
sources: Exophase — Grand Theft Auto VI trophy list
PSNProfiles — Grand Theft Auto VI trophy guide
trophies.guide: Smash your way out of a vehicle showroom in classic style. Pick a showroom, pick a fast car, and go straight through the glass.

trophies.name: Let’s Go Bowling
trophies.description: Follow-through at the Kolt & Associates' bowling alley.
sources: Exophase — Grand Theft Auto VI trophy list
PSNProfiles — Grand Theft Auto VI trophy guide
trophies.guide: Follow through at the Kolt & Associates' bowling alley. Play a full game — aim for the pocket and follow through.

trophies.name: Personal Best
sources: Exophase — Grand Theft Auto VI trophy list
PSNProfiles — Grand Theft Auto VI trophy guide
trophies.guide: A partnership moment with mass appeal. This one comes from playing through the partner story — it unlocks as your partnership grows.

trophies.name: Actions Speak Louder
sources: Exophase — Grand Theft Auto VI trophy list
PSNProfiles — Grand Theft Auto VI trophy guide
trophies.guide: Make choices along the way. The game tracks the decisions you make — keep playing and choosing, and this pops as the count builds.

trophies.name: Bad Luck, I Guess
sources: Exophase — Grand Theft Auto VI trophy list
PSNProfiles — Grand Theft Auto VI trophy guide
trophies.guide: Succeed on a second try. If something fails once, try it again — the second attempt is the one that counts.

trophies.name: The Truth Is Out There
sources: Exophase — Grand Theft Auto VI trophy list
PSNProfiles — Grand Theft Auto VI trophy guide
trophies.guide: Witness something strange. Keep your eyes open while exploring Leonida's odd corners — strange things happen when you least expect them.

trophies.name: Ten Pin
trophies.description: Bowl 'em over with a melee drive-by.
sources: Exophase — Grand Theft Auto VI trophy list
PSNProfiles — Grand Theft Auto VI trophy guide
trophies.guide: Bowl 'em over with a melee drive-by. Line up a slow pass with a melee weapon ready and swing as you roll past.

trophies.name: Dime on the Dollar
trophies.description: Earn $250,000 laundering Marked Bills through your contacts.
sources: Exophase — Grand Theft Auto VI trophy list
PSNProfiles — Grand Theft Auto VI trophy guide
trophies.guide: Earn $250,000 laundering Marked Bills through your contacts. Run marked bills through your contacts steadily — it adds up across many jobs, so start early.

trophies.name: Treat Yo Self
sources: Exophase — Grand Theft Auto VI trophy list
PSNProfiles — Grand Theft Auto VI trophy guide
trophies.guide: Spend $100,000 across all shops. Weapons, clothes, vehicles and upgrades all count — big purchases late in the game finish this off fast.

trophies.name: Little Boxes
sources: Exophase — Grand Theft Auto VI trophy list
PSNProfiles — Grand Theft Auto VI trophy guide
trophies.guide: Purchase all garage properties. Save up and buy them as they become available — they also give you storage for the vehicle collection.

trophies.name: On the Spot
trophies.description: Register 10 vehicles to the Scooter Bros app.
sources: Exophase — Grand Theft Auto VI trophy list
PSNProfiles — Grand Theft Auto VI trophy guide
trophies.guide: Register 10 vehicles to the Scooter Bros app. Find ten different vehicles, open the app, and register each one — variety counts, duplicates do not.
